verdict.rationale: Codegen's first-party docs describe installing a GitHub App to give the agent repository access, with no complex setup required. They also document that agents can create pull requests, commit code, and create branches, and that this PR-creation permission can be toggled per organization. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the GitHub connection and PR workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect a GitHub repository so an agent can access the code and open pull requests against it

citations.quote: Install the GitHub App to grant the agent access to your repositories. No complex setup required.
Agents can create new pull requests with code changes
Review PRs, suggest changes, comment on issues, create branches, commit code, and manage repositories.
Control whether the codegen agent is able to create pull requests in your repositories in response to user requests.
